acct_help_asset: Assets: what the business owns (cash, inventory, equipment). Debit increases, credit decreases. Examples: Cash (1101), Bank (1102), Inventory (1104).
acct_help_liability: Liabilities: what the business owes (loans, payables). Credit increases, debit decreases. Examples: Accounts Payable (2101).
acct_help_equity: Equity: owner's claim on assets. Credit increases. Examples: Capital (3101), Retained Earnings (3102).
acct_help_revenue: Revenue: income from sales/services. Credit increases. Examples: Sales Revenue (4101), Parts Sales (4102), Service Revenue (4103), Other Revenue (4104).
acct_help_expense: Expenses: costs of running the business. Debit increases. Examples: COGS (5101), Operating Expenses (5102).
acct_help_codes: 1xxx = Assets, 2xxx = Liabilities, 3xxx = Equity, 4xxx = Revenue, 5xxx = Expenses. Use Parent Account to create hierarchy (e.g., Current Assets under Assets).
acct_help_integration: When you create a Sale, the system auto-generates: Debit Cash/Bank (1101/1102), Credit Sales Revenue (4101). Returns reverse. Purchases: Debit Inventory (1104), Credit Accounts Payable (2101). Stock Adjustments affect Inventory directly.
